2609.35664.title: MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution
2609.35664.paper_summary: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size. This multi-resolution decomposition draws on principles from Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM), adapting them to the gated linear attention setting. We evaluate MS-GLA on language modeling, recall-intensive tasks, and long-context generalization. Across all settings, MS-GLA consistently achieves higher accuracy and lower perplexity than GLA at matched parameter counts, with up to 18.9% improvement on recall-intensive tasks and 9.5% lower average perplexity on language modeling benchmarks, validating multi-temporal resolution decomposition as a principled and effective extension of Gated Linear Attention.
2609.35664.paper_summary_zh: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers 透過數據依賴的門控技術推進了線性遞迴模型，但面臨一個核心限制：所有頭部的固定容量記憶矩陣在單一時間解析度下運作，每個標記都是單獨處理，迫使它們同時編碼局部語法模式和長距離語義結構，這創造了一個表徵瓶頸，僅靠門控無法解決。我們引入了多尺度門控線性注意力 (MS-GLA)，通過在多個時間解析度之間分配注意力頭來解決這個問題。較粗的解析度自然地聚合較長的標記範圍，專注於長距離依賴，而較細的頭組則保持對局部語法結構的敏感性。一個可學習的、依賴於輸入的融合層在每個時間步動態地重新組合頭組的輸出，擴大了有效的記憶容量，而不增加每個頭的狀態大小。這種多解析度分解借鑒了多尺度狀態空間模型 (MS-SSM) 的原則，並將其適應於門控線性注意力的設置。我們在語言建模、回憶密集型任務和長上下文泛化上評估了 MS-GLA。在所有設置中，MS-GLA 在匹配的參數數量下，始終實現了比 GLA 更高的準確率和更低的困惑度，在回憶密集型任務上提高了多達 18.9% 的表現，以及在語言建模基準上平均困惑度降低了 9.5%，驗證了多時間解析度分解作為門控線性注意力的一個原則性和有效的擴展。
